promises.quote: we think the overall full year growth will be between 22% to 23%.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 call, p.3: “AUM, as you can see, grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores, delivering net AUM addition of close to INR 38,000 crores in the quarter.”; Q4 FY26 call, p.3: “In Q4, AUM grew by 22.4% and PAT grew by 26.7%.”
promises.why: R26 shows AUM grew 22.4%, within 22‑23% target.

promises.quote: We're likely to be between 7.55% to 7.60% in terms of cost of funds as we exit the year.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 call, p.4: “Cost of funds came down sequentially by 9 basis points and came in at 7.31%.”; Q4 FY26 call, p.4: “Cost of funds improved by 4 basis points in Q4 and came in at 7.41%.”
promises.why: Reported 7.31% (Q2 FY27 call) against ≤7.6%; compared in Python.

promises.quote: ROA came in as of fourth quarter at 4.6%. We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 call, p.3: “ROA for the quarter came in at 4.6% and ROE came in at 20.6%.”; Q1 FY27 call, p.4: “ROA came in at 4.7% and ROE at 20.4%.”
promises.why: Reported 4.6% (Q2 FY27 call) against 4.4–4.6%; compared in Python.

promises.quote: We foresee that the number next year as we enter could be anywhere between 165 to 175 basis points
promises.why: No reported metric for credit cost provided.

promises.quote: In terms of AUM, we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years as they begin to scale.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 call, p.3: “AUM, as you can see, grew by 26.5% to INR 5,84,624 crores, delivering net AUM addition of close to INR 38,000 crores in the quarter.”
promises.why: The period runs to Mar 2027; a part-period number can't be a miss yet.

promises.target: continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels
promises.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.
promises.why: No reported basis‑point improvement data for opex to NTI.
